_comment: LLM pricing overrides — USD per 1,000,000 tokens as [input, output] (or {"input":, "output":}). Loaded by utils/llm_observability.py to cost every call for `python -m tools.llm_usage`. These are approximate public list prices; edit to match your account/contract. Keys are matched case-insensitively by longest model-name prefix, so dated/versioned model ids (e.g. gpt-4o-mini-2026-01-01) resolve to their family. Keys starting with _ or // are ignored. Local providers are free.
